phase_name: Content-Addressed Corpus and Implementation Digest Library

objectives.description: Create scripts/lib/gate-cache-lib.sh with corpus-resolution function reusing gate_registry_shared_corpus_build
Compute corpus digest content-addressably (no mtime); prove touch invariance
Compute implementation digest over the five key components
Return single composite key per gate; distinguishable cannot-compute sentinel on every failure mode
Add tests/test-gate-cache-lib.sh covering touch/content/add/delete/rename/untracked/-, unresolvable, missing-git, sourced-lib, determinism
Record digest algorithm, inputs, and explicit non-inputs in the library header

approaches_tried.approach: resolving non-named-view corpus entries (literal paths, bare directories, globs) via 'git ls-files -z -- <entry>'
approaches_tried.reason: git ls-files only returns TRACKED paths. Many real declared corpus entries point at the .claude/ deployed tree, which is deliberately gitignored (a disposable, regenerated deploy artifact). Every such entry silently resolved to zero paths, producing EMPTY_CORPUS_... for gates whose corpus is genuinely non-empty (e.g. gate 2's .claude/settings.json). Fixed by resolving these three entry shapes against the FILESYSTEM directly (existence checks and `find`), reserving git ls-files for the two named views (@extensions, @repo) only, which are explicitly defined as the tracked enumeration.

approaches_tried.approach: propagating GATE_CACHE_UNRESOLVED out of gate_cache_resolve_corpus via command substitution ($(gate_cache_resolve_corpus ...))
approaches_tried.reason: command substitution forks a subshell; a function's global variable assignments inside it (GATE_CACHE_UNRESOLVED=true) never reach the caller, only its stdout does. gate_cache_corpus_digest for gate 14 (declared '-') silently fell through to the zero-matches branch instead of the sentinel branch. Fixed by having gate_cache_resolve_corpus set GATE_CACHE_RESOLVED_FILE and GATE_CACHE_UNRESOLVED as direct out-parameters via a plain (non-substituted) call, with callers reading both globals immediately afterward.

approaches_tried.approach: testing the missing-git-binary sentinel path by replacing PATH wholesale (export PATH="$FAKEBIN") rather than prepending it
approaches_tried.reason: removed every other coreutils tool (mktemp, rm, sort, comm, find) from PATH too, breaking the library's own internals before it ever reached the git-availability check, and producing a misleading false result. Fixed by prepending the fake-git directory ahead of the real PATH (PATH="$FAKEBIN:$PATH") so only `git` resolution is shadowed.

approaches_tried.approach: computing the test suite's ROOT variable as $CORE_DIR/../../.. (3 levels up)
approaches_tried.reason: this suite's own CORE_DIR naming convention (shared with test-gate-registry-resolution.sh) resolves to .../agent-system/extensions/core/scripts, not .../core -- 3 levels up from scripts/ lands at agent-system/, one level short of the real repo root, causing case1 to silently skip (looking for .claude/settings.json under agent-system/.claude/ instead of the repo root) and cascading several digest-dependent cases into false CANNOT_COMPUTE results. Fixed to 4 levels up.

verification.manual_smoke: touch invariance, content-change detection, restoration-matches-original, add/delete/rename detection (synthetic git repo), registry-row-change invalidation, sourced-library-change invalidation, invoke-body-change invalidation (synthetic verify-deploy.sh), target-mode discrimination, missing-git sentinel across all three public functions, determinism sequential and concurrent (4 parallel processes) -- all verified live before being encoded into the committed suite
verification.no_caller_yet: confirmed: gate-cache-lib.sh is sourced nowhere outside its own test suite as of this phase; verify-deploy.sh itself untouched
